findings.problem: Factual: 'to finish off Denver' says the shot ended the series. The stored quote says the 105–103 win gave a 2–0 series lead (Game 2).

question.prompt: LeBron scored Cleveland's final 25 points in a 2007 playoff game. How many straight points did AD score to beat Denver in 2020 Game 2?

findings.problem: Two claims lack support. (a) The prompt says 'The NBA's longest game went 6 overtimes in 1951', but the support quote (Shot clock article) only says a six-overtime game was played, not that it was the longest, and the fact has no date. (b) The reveal says 'first quadruple-overtime playoff game of the shot-clock era', but the stored quote says 'first ... since 1955', and 1955 is already the shot-clock era. Either re-check the quote or match the reveal to it.

question.prompt: Before the shot clock, a 1950–51 game went 6 overtimes. How many overtimes did Portland and Denver play in 2019 playoff Game 3?
question.reveal: Four overtimes! It was the first quadruple-overtime playoff game since 1955.

Raising max to 8 puts the anchor on the ruler (answer at 11%, 80 steps) and the reworded prompt is accurate.

findings.problem: Scope mismatch and a repeated anchor. Kobe's 32.4 is a 5-game Finals average, set against Stoudemire's 15-game full-playoff average. The same 'Kobe Bryant averaged 32.4 points in the 2009 Finals.' sentence already opens 2027-01-01 Q3. findings.problem: Arc repetition. 17 of the 29 days now end on a 'Famous X did N. How many did Y?' reference Q5 (Dec 30, 31; Jan 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 22, 26 among them). Some anchors are reused: Kyrie's 53 s on Jan 11 and Jan 22, Kobe's 32.4 on Jan 1 and Jan 12, Stockton's 14.5 on Dec 30 and Jan 9. Four rebound-average charts (Jan 2, 13, 14, 27) and two near-identical ppg and apg charts (Jan 9/17, Dec 30/Jan 26) repeat the same players. No single-slot patch fixes this; it needs a sequencing pass that moves some reference finales to recall or difference.
